$comment: Release-certification waivers. TRACKED IN GIT ON PURPOSE: a waiver is a human
decision to ship with a known unproven or failing axis, and it must be reviewable
in history, not discoverable only in a local evidence directory.
ONLY THE HUMAN MAY ADD AN ENTRY HERE. An agent must never author a waiver, and
must never add one to obtain a GREEN run.
Every entry requires all six fields. A waiver without an accountable owner and a
review date is an indefinite suppression wearing a different name:
id            stable identifier, e.g. W-2026-001; must be unique
axis          the axis id being waived (must exist and be waivable)
reason        why shipping with this unproven or failing is acceptable
owner         who carries the residual risk
authorizedBy  who approved it
expires       YYYY-MM-DD or a full UTC instant (2026-12-31T23:59:59Z).
Locale-ambiguous forms such as 12/31/2026 are REJECTED.
A waiver can only downgrade FAIL or INCOMPLETE to WAIVED. It can never produce
PASS, and the original status is preserved in the evidence as `waivedFrom`.
REJECTED AUTOMATICALLY, each as a governance error that forces the run verdict
off GREEN: a duplicate id, a second active waiver for the same axis, an unknown
axis, an ambiguous expiry, and any waiver naming a NON-WAIVABLE axis.
NON-WAIVABLE AXES are declared in scripts/release/axes/index.mjs, not here.
Currently image-vulnerabilities and component-inventory: Tranche 8 names the
container-scan and SBOM gaps as explicit release blockers that must be CLOSED,
not waived. Relaxing that requires a reviewed code change, not a JSON edit.
Deliberately empty: no release-blocking exception is authorized.
